messages:
maya: Hey team — request a very short admin window (5–10m) to run a DB schema tidy on prod-read replica. No writes to primary, just ALTERs on replica for index cleanup. Will be during low traffic at 22:30 PT. I need console/admin for a port-forward + apply migration job.

kevin: can you paste the runbook/PR + jira id? we need the link for audit. also confirm you’ll use an ephemeral role not long-lived creds.

maya: jira: RED-4823. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/repo/pull/1234 — runbook excerpt below:```
# steps
1) run port-forward to prod-replica: `kubectl port-forward svc/prod-replica 5432:5432 -n prod`
2) run `pg_dump --schema-only --table=events > schema.sql` (verify)
3) apply ALTERs via migration job image `infra/migrate:v2.1`
4) smoke queries, rollback if error
```
I will not touch PII tables. Only index/meta tables.

sec-bot: Reminder: for admin windows we require: a) ephemeral IAM session bound to this thread id; b) session recording ON; c) a short postmortem within 24h. Please confirm.

oli: +1 to ephemeral role. maya, can you run the port-forward from your workstation or from bastion? bastion is preferred (less local creds footprint). If bastion, I'll pre-create a limited session role for 10m.

maya: will use bastion. request session length: 15m (to allow cushion). start 22:30 PT.

sanjay: Quick checks from security: we need the exact list of DB objects you'll change, and a statement that no user emails or customer identifiers will be exported. Also enable query logging for the session and route logs through redact pipeline. If all that is good I can approve ephemeral console for 15m.

maya: objects: `idx_events_old`, `idx_user_activity_tmp`. both are indexes on events_* partitions. no data exports. confirmed no PII. will turn on query-logging `log_statement = 'ddl'` and push logs to `s3://redwood-audit/staging/2145001111/` (redact pipeline auto-run).

sec-bot: Policy check OK — ephemeral role template `ephemeral-admin-lite-v3` matches requested scope. Please include the session id in the migration job env var: `AUDIT_SESSION=2145001111`.

oli: provisioning role now. will post the one-time MFA link ~5m before start.

kevin: tagging @oncall to monitor latency spike during apply. good to go from infra if sec approves.

sanjay: Approved CONDITIONS: 1) session uses ephemeral-admin-lite-v3 2) logs sent to s3 path above and redaction pipeline runs 3) postmortem in 24h with command output sanitized. Approving console access for 15m starting 22:30 PT.

maya: thanks all — will paste sanitized diff + short postmortem in #eng-runtime within 24h. :thumbsup:
